nom: IT Cosmetics Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating Moisturizer

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including those in cold or dry climates, report strong, long-lasting hydration and reduced flakiness, though a few say the moisture fades within a few hours.
segments.combination: The two reviewers who describe combination skin report the cream balances a T-zone that shifts between dry and oily without feeling heavy.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who describe sensitive skin report no irritation or breakouts, but a handful with sensitive skin report allergic reactions, severe breakouts, or intolerance to the fragrance.
segments.normal: The one reviewer with normal to slightly dry skin describes a rich but non-heavy feel with soft, comfortable, hydrated skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention being in their late 40s to 50s report firmer, softer skin and some softening of fine lines with continued use, though a few say they have not yet seen a difference in wrinkles.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report softer-looking fine lines, firmer skin, and a plumper appearance with continued use; a few others say they have not seen a visible difference in wrinkles yet.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe deep, long-lasting hydration that keeps skin soft through the day, though a couple report the moisture wearing off within a few hours or the cream not moisturizing enough for their skin.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers, including one with rosacea and one whose skin normally turns red with moisturizers, report the cream did not trigger redness.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers credit the ceramides and peptides with strengthening the skin barrier and extending how long their skin stays hydrated.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including some with sensitive or acne-prone skin, report no new breakouts; a comparable number, across a range of skin types, describe breakouts, a severe allergic-type reaction, or worsening acne after use.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers report the cream left their skin feeling oily or greasy, while most others describe it as non-greasy.

aspects.libelle: Rich texture that absorbs without residue

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Scent was great but this product was a little harsh for my skin. I had a full break out on my whole face that was very severe I would advise to not use on sensitive areas

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] have mature skin, rosacea, and am generally super picky with skin care. It always takes me days before I dare to try a new product. It's har di strike a balance between not gloopy but still rich enough, or rich enough and sitting on the skin. This strikes the perfect balance for my skin. It is creamy and pleasant on the skin and sinks in well. My skin feels soft next morning. I wish it did't have a fragrance, that usually determines me from a fragrance.

extraits.titre: New holy grail cream for dry skin and mature skin
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've tried dozens of moisturizers, but IT Cosmetics Confidence in a Cream is the only one that actually makes my skin look "bouncy" again. What I Love: • The Texture: It's thick and buttery but absorbs quickly. No greasy residue! • Instant Results: My fine lines look "filled in" and smoothed out almost immediately after applying. • Makeup Friendly: It doubles as an amazing primer; my foundation doesn't pill or settle into creases when I use this underneath. • Skin Barrier Hero: My skin used to feel tight and itchy by midday, but the ceramides and peptides in this keep me hydrated for 48 hours. Things to Note: It does have a very light citrus scent, which I find refreshing, but keep that in mind if you're sensitive to fragrance. Bottom Line: If you have dry or mature skin and want that "filter in a jar" look, this is worth every penny. A little goes a long way!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product for my honest review. My skin has a tendency to turn red with moisturizers. This product protects my skin from redness. After use my skin feels smoother and hydrated. The scent is delightful. The product creamy and goes on smoothly with a little amount. I have noticed a remarkable difference in my skin by using this product!

extraits.titre: Great moisturizer for sensitive aging skin!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoyed this moisturizer. It is incredibly hydrated which makes it really great for the winter season but it's also unscented which as somebody who is sensitive to fragrance in their skin care I am so happy to find something that works so well and it's unscented. The cream is thick but it melts beautifully into the skin. A little bit goes a long way. It leaves your skin feeling well moisturized and protected and protects it all day long. Would make a great evening cream as well I just don't wear night moisturizer. I also have sensitive skin and this has not caused any breakouts which is also very impressive for a heavy duty moisturizer!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cream is very moisturizing. Skin feels plump and feels good on the skin not too oily just the right moisture. I have seen good results with continued use with the niacinamide and peptide properties it's great for mature skin. Value for the money is great jar will last a while as you only need a little product to go a long way.
